sql:

FROM Voucher

JOIN Store AS Store_2 ON Inv_Voucher.COUNTER_PART_STORE_ID = Store_2.id
JOIN Inv_Voucher_Item ON Inv_Voucher.id = Inv_Voucher_Item.INVENTORY_VOUCHER_ID
JOIN Voucher_Specification ON Voucher_Specification.Id = Inv_Voucher.Voucher_Specification_id

	AND store.title LIKE ‘%مواد اولیه مصرفی تولید%’

	AND Inv_Voucher.STATE IN (

		,’ثبت شده’)
	AND VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION.Voucher_Type = ‘انتقال بین انبار’

```sql
SELECT 
    I.STORE_REF2 
FROM 
    INV_VOUCHER I
JOIN 
    INV_VOUCHER_ITEM IVI ON I.ID = IVI.INVENTORY_VOUCHER_REF
WHERE 
    I.DATE = CURDATE()
    AND IVI.PART_REF = (SELECT ID FROM PART WHERE TITLE = 'DRI')

    AND I.VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION_REF IN (SELECT ID FROM VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION WHERE VOUCHER_TYPE = 'مصرف');
```
